defects.title: Bahia initial deployment hookup is not implemented for newly provisioned souls
evidence: internal/soulfactory/provisioner_full.go:324-343 logs Bahia registration, then treats initial deployment as skipped or failed instead of establishing the required hookup.
internal/soulfactory/bahia_integration.go:77-88 returns ErrDeployableArtifactRequired immediately from CreateInitialDeployment whenever an agent environment is configured.
pstf/features/SOUL_FACTORY_PROVISIONING_TRACKING/acceptance_criteria.json (SFTP-AC-007) requires initial deployment hookup now.
`go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli` passed on 2026-05-04, confirming the current code path but not proving the required hookup behavior.

Patched on 2026-05-04 with focused regression coverage: `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli`, `cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/souls-store.test.js`, and `cd web && npm run build` all passed.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The Bahia integration layer still stops at service registration and has no implemented artifact/deployment-intent path for freshly provisioned souls.
defects.recommended_fix: Implement CreateInitialDeployment for configured Bahia environments and add deterministic Bahia integration coverage for service registration, deployment-intent creation, and deploy-status visibility.

defects.title: Bahia-managed lifecycle actions do not propagate required runtime side effects
evidence: internal/soulfactory/bahia_integration.go:204-305 routes suspend/resume/revoke/redeploy into helpers that all return ErrLifecycleUnsupported before any runtime-side effect work occurs.
internal/soulfactory/lifecycle_handler.go:91-170 only warns when Bahia suspend/resume/revoke fails, then still republishes soul updates and marks the action completed.
internal/soulfactory/lifecycle_handler.go:224-236 hard-fails redeploy if Bahia integration cannot perform the side effect.
pstf/features/SOUL_FACTORY_PROVISIONING_TRACKING/acceptance_criteria.json (SFTP-AC-009) requires managed deployment and access side effects, not local-only acknowledgements.

Patched on 2026-05-04 with focused regression coverage: `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli`, `cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/souls-store.test.js`, and `cd web && npm run build` all passed.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Lifecycle handler and Bahia integration were wired for eventual runtime control, but the actual Bahia side-effect methods remain stubbed and completion signaling was left optimistic for several actions.
defects.recommended_fix: Implement Bahia lifecycle side effects for suspend/resume/revoke/redeploy, then add deterministic lifecycle integration tests that assert both side effects and resulting soul/action state.

defects.title: Soul Factory CLI commands remain explicit unavailable stubs
evidence: cmd/cli/soulfactory.go:68-301 returns soulFactoryUnavailableErr(...) for list, get, provision, suspend, resume, revoke, redeploy, regenerate, and template commands.
cmd/cli/soulfactory_test.go only contains TestSoulFactoryCLIListUnavailable and TestSoulFactoryCLIProvisionDoesNotSimulateSuccess.
`go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli` passed on 2026-05-04, which means the repo currently proves the stubbed CLI behavior, not the approved contract.

Patched on 2026-05-04 with focused regression coverage: `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli`, `cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/souls-store.test.js`, and `cd web && npm run build` all passed.
defects.suspected_root_cause: CLI command scaffolding and request-shaping helpers were added before any real signer/query/publish transport was implemented.
defects.recommended_fix: Add real Nostr-backed CLI query/publish support and replace the unavailable-stub tests with deterministic relay-harness coverage for list/get/provision/lifecycle/template commands.

defects.title: Soul Factory MCP mutation and list/template surfaces remain unavailable
evidence: internal/soulfactory/mcp_server.go:223-307 returns explicit unavailable errors for list_souls, list_templates, provision, action, and regenerate.
internal/soulfactory/mcp_server.go:227-320 only provides partial real behavior for get_soul and get_status.
internal/soulfactory/hardening_test.go:107-116 contains TestMCPServerReturnsUnavailableInsteadOfMockData, which passed under `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli` on 2026-05-04.

Patched on 2026-05-04 with focused regression coverage: `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli`, `cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/souls-store.test.js`, and `cd web && npm run build` all passed.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The MCP surface was intentionally fail-closed until signed Nostr publish/query support existed, but the approved feature contract now requires those real operations.
defects.recommended_fix: Implement signed Nostr-backed MCP list/template/provision/action/regenerate flows and add deterministic MCP tool coverage for both query and mutation paths.

defects.title: Browser provisioning tracking still treats timeout and relay closure as terminal failure
evidence: web/src/lib/stores/souls.svelte.js:148-234 defines PROVISIONING_EVENT_TIMEOUT_MS, starts a setInterval timeout loop, and fails the run from onClosed and elapsed local time.
web/tests/unit/souls-store.test.js passed 33 tests on 2026-05-04, preserving the legacy timeout/relay-closure expectations rather than the approved event-driven contract.
HITL-SOUL_FACTORY_PROVISIONING_TRACKING-002 and SFTP-AC-013 explicitly classify timeout/closure terminal behavior as FIX, not normative.

Patched on 2026-05-04 with focused regression coverage: `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli`, `cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/souls-store.test.js`, and `cd web && npm run build` all passed.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The browser tracker was built around local liveness heuristics before the product decision tightened completion semantics around explicit correlated result events.
defects.recommended_fix: Remove timeout/relay-closure terminal completion logic from the browser tracker, replace it with explicit publish rejection and correlated result semantics, and invert the unit tests accordingly.

defects.title: Soul deploy-status synchronization still depends on periodic polling fallback
evidence: internal/soulfactory/status_sync.go:38-111 implements event-driven handlers, but status_sync.go:213-262 also exposes StartPeriodicSync and syncAllSouls ticker polling over every registered soul.
HITL-SOUL_FACTORY_PROVISIONING_TRACKING-003 and SFTP-AC-014 explicitly classify ticker-based polling as FIX, not intended contract behavior.
No internal/soulfactory/status_sync_test.go exists, so no automated evidence proves an event-driven-only replacement path.

Patched on 2026-05-04 with focused regression coverage: `go test ./internal/soulfactory ./cmd/cli`, `cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/souls-store.test.js`, and `cd web && npm run build` all passed.
defects.suspected_root_cause: An operational fallback was left in place instead of completing the event-driven deployment-status propagation contract.
defects.recommended_fix: Remove StartPeriodicSync from the approved path, rely on explicit Bahia events for deploy-status changes, and add deterministic status-sync tests that inject deployment events directly.

defects.title: Required backend provisioning and lifecycle verification suites are missing
evidence: RepoPrompt path search on 2026-05-04 found no internal/soulfactory/reactor_test.go, provisioner_full_integration_test.go, or lifecycle_handler_test.go files.

internal/soulfactory/reactor.go, provisioner_full.go, and lifecycle_handler.go contain logic for request rejection, progress publication, soul publication, action authorization, and regenerate semantics, but no required automated verification suite currently exercises those contracts.
pstf/features/SOUL_FACTORY_PROVISIONING_TRACKING/test_matrix.json maps these ACs to missing tests T-004, T-005, T-007, T-008, T-012, and T-014.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The full-lifecycle acceptance criteria were approved before corresponding in-process backend regression harnesses were built.
defects.recommended_fix: Add deterministic in-process tests for reactor request/result handling, eight-stage provisioning, authoritative 31951 publication, action authorization, and regenerate semantics.

evidence: RepoPrompt path search on 2026-05-04 found no web/tests/e2e/souls-gallery-live.spec.js or soul-provisioned-visibility.spec.js files.
`cd /Users/bizarro/Documents/Projects/bahia/web && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/soul-signing-smoke.spec.js` failed on 2026-05-04: 6 passed, 1 failed.

web/test-results/soul-signing-smoke-Soul-Si-0683c-when-no-extension-available-chromium/error-context.md shows the failing no-extension test landed on Dashboard because AuthGuard redirected unauthenticated /souls/new access to / before any Continue button existed.
